notes: Visual master skin release based on the approved open-book reference. Deepens the dark wood/leather surround, warms the parchment pages, strengthens antique-brass borders and stitched tabs, shifts headings and character titles toward an elegant book-like Georgia treatment, and harmonizes ordinary inputs/buttons with the parchment UI. The skin is reapplied after every character/section render so navigation and refreshes keep the look. The existing page-turn animation is disabled to match the approved reference. Preserves the book frame/page controls, status and section tabs, Notes, Timeline, Story, Powers, custom color-picker persistence, updater behavior, and separate user data. Windows PowerShell parsing and package/hash verification passed before publish.
